criteria.criterion: Navigate Xbox.com to the 'Best sellers' section
criteria.final_justification: Because none of the screenshots visually confirm reaching a section labeled “Best sellers” (or an equivalent clearly best-selling list), the baseline 3/3 is not supported by evidence. However, the agent did navigate to the Xbox Games/Store area where such a list could exist, so some partial credit for reasonable attempt is warranted.

criteria.criterion: Open a product page for a game from 'Best sellers'
criteria.final_justification: The agent definitively opened a valid Xbox product page (meets core of this criterion), but provenance from a “Best sellers” section cannot be verified from the provided visual evidence. Award partial credit rather than full.

criteria.criterion: Report publisher, developer, and release date from the product page
criteria.final_justification: The page contains all three required fields, but the agent’s final answer incorrectly claims the publisher value wasn’t visible and fails to report it. Since the correct publisher was available and visible, this is a controllable omission/error. Give credit only for correctly reporting developer and release date.

criteria.criterion: Respect constraints (no sign-in; no purchase or download; stop after recording details)
criteria.final_justification: Constraints appear respected: no sign-in and no purchase/download was initiated/completed. Although the agent’s final response did not successfully record all required fields, it did stop without violating constraints.
